content.text:
I fixed `addMonths` in `dates.js`. The bug was that `setMonth` on the 31st overflows into the next month, so Jan 31 + 1 month came out as Mar 3.

The function now sets the day to 1, changes the month, then sets the day to the smaller of the original day and the new month's last day.

I ran it directly on these cases, and all matched the rules in the file's header comment:
- Jan 31 2026 + 1 month gives Feb 28 2026, and the 13:45 time of day is kept.
- Jan 31 2024 + 1 month gives Feb 29 2024, a leap year.
- Mar 31 + 1 month gives Apr 30.
- Jan 15 + 1 month gives Feb 15.
- Jan 31 2026 − 2 months gives Nov 30 2025.
- Nov 30 2026 + 3 months gives Feb 28 2027.
- The input date was not changed.

The project has no tests (`npm test` ran 0), so I didn't add any. I can add a test file for these cases if you want.
